entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: So, what, you've prevented it now? You've... Prevented alien colonization by injecting this metal into my son?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Your son is the one thing the aliens need. I took revenge on my father by taking William away from them.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: So, he's all right now? I mean, just like that? So it's over. They'll let him be.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It'll never be over. They'll always know what he was. They'll never accept what he is.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Well, I can protect him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And if you can't? Look at me......what they did. Is this what you want for your son?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Dana... The room's all fresh for you. I threw out all the old bedding and bought some brand-new stuff, okay?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I know it's impossible to stop thinking about what he said about William... But it's all lies, Dana and you were the one who proved it.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: And how should I prove it now? By insisting that I can protect him......only to learn too late that I can't?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You say it as if you have a choice.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: He didn't have a choice to come into this life. I don't have a choice about what he is or was......but I do have a choice about the life my son will have......and shouldn't I choose that he never have to be afraid of anyone or anything? And can I ever really even promise him that?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: But who can?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes
